name: MonarchApprovalChainEditor
title: ApprovalChainEditor
wrapsNative: MonarchReorderableList (androidx.compose.foundation.lazy.LazyColumn with a long-press drag and TalkBack move actions) of steps built from MonarchSelect (androidx.compose.material3.ExposedDropdownMenuBox), MonarchEntityPicker (androidx.compose.material3.ModalBottomSheet) and MonarchTextField (androidx.compose.material3.OutlinedTextField)
summary: Edits the ordered steps of an approval chain: who approves each step (a kind of approver, plus a role or person where the kind needs one), an optional label, and the order, with add, remove and accessible reordering.
whenToUse: An admin sets up multi-step approval for requests such as leave, expenses, purchases or access, where each step names a kind of approver and sometimes a role or person.
whenNotToUse: To show how one request moved through its chain, use MonarchApprovalTimeline. When conditions decide what happens, use MonarchConditionEditor with MonarchActionEditor.
api: @Composable public fun MonarchApprovalChainEditor(value: List<MonarchApprovalChainStep>, onValueChange: (List<MonarchApprovalChainStep>) -> Unit, approverTypes: List<MonarchApprovalApproverType>, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, description: String? = null, minSteps: Int = 1, maxSteps: Int = 10, showLabels: Boolean = true, showErrors: Boolean = false, enabled: Boolean = true, createStep: (() -> MonarchApprovalChainStep)? = null, removeIcon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, addIcon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, state: LazyListState = rememberLazyListState(), labels: MonarchApprovalChainEditorLabels = MonarchApprovalChainEditorLabels())

public data class MonarchApprovalChainStep(id: String, approver: String, target: String? = null, label: String? = null) { companion object { fun validate(steps: List<MonarchApprovalChainStep>, approverTypes: List<MonarchApprovalApproverType>): Set<String>; fun summarize(steps: List<MonarchApprovalChainStep>, approverTypes: List<MonarchApprovalApproverType>, separator: String = " → "): String } }
public class MonarchApprovalApproverType(value: String, label: String, targets: List<MonarchEntityPickerEntity>? = null, targetLabel: String? = null)

public class MonarchApprovalChainEditorLabels(title: String? = null, step: ((position: Int) -> String)? = null, approver: String? = null, target: String? = null, targetPlaceholder: String? = null, label: String? = null, labelPlaceholder: String? = null, addStep: String? = null, remove: String? = null, removeStep: ((position: Int) -> String)? = null, targetRequired: String? = null, maxReached: ((max: Int) -> String)? = null, reorder: MonarchReorderableListLabels = MonarchReorderableListLabels())

options.name: value
options.description: The steps, in order. Ids must be unique.

options.name: onValueChange
options.description: Called with the whole new list after every edit, move, add or remove.

options.name: approverTypes
options.description: The kinds of approver; the first is used for new steps. A kind with targets adds a MonarchEntityPicker to its steps.

options.name: modifier
options.description: The modifier of the editor. Give it a bounded height.

options.name: description
options.description: Help under the heading, such as how skipped steps work.

options.name: minSteps
options.description: The fewest steps; the remove buttons are disabled at this count.

options.name: maxSteps
options.description: The most steps; the add button is replaced by a note at this count.

options.name: showLabels
options.description: Shows the optional label field (up to 60 characters) on each step.

options.name: showErrors
options.description: Shows Choose who decides this step on steps without a target, for example after a save attempt.

options.name: enabled
options.description: Whether the chain can be changed.

options.name: createStep
options.description: Makes a new step; by default the first kind with the first free step-<n> id.

options.name: removeIcon
options.description: The icon of each remove button; without it the button reads Remove.

options.name: addIcon
options.description: An icon before the text of the add button.

options.name: state
options.description: The scroll state of the list of steps.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for the built-in strings, including those of the reorderable list.

states.name: editing
states.description: Each step shows its heading, remove button, approver menu, target picker when the kind has targets, and label field.

states.name: dragging
states.description: A long press lifts a step; the other steps move out of its way and the new order is reported on drop.

states.name: incomplete
states.description: With showErrors, a step without a target shows Choose who decides this step as the picker's error.

states.name: at the limit
states.description: The add button is replaced by A chain can have up to 10 steps.

states.name: disabled
states.description: Every field and button is disabled and nothing can be moved.

appearance: A Subheading heading, then the reorderable rows with their drag handles and Up and Down buttons from MonarchReorderableList; each step has a strong heading, outlined menus and fields with the input border, and the add button is a small secondary MonarchButton. The description and notes use the muted text color. Light, dark and both high-contrast themes follow from the color roles.
platformNotes: Same data shape, defaults and checks as the web (validateApprovalChain and summarizeApprovalChain are MonarchApprovalChainStep.validate and summarize; validate returns the ids of incomplete steps). Targets are MonarchEntityPickerEntity values shown in MonarchEntityPicker, a searchable sheet with avatars, where the web uses a native select of options. The web's messages prop is labels, as in other Android components. The list is a LazyColumn (MonarchReorderableList), so the editor needs a bounded height and cannot sit in a vertically scrolling parent; the web's fieldset grows with the page. Focus after a remove is left to Compose. There is no iOS entry yet.
accessibility: The list heading and each step's heading (Step 1) are headings; each step is read as a traversal group.
Each step's drag handle offers Move up and Move down as TalkBack custom actions, and Up and Down buttons are shown on every row, so no step needs a drag.
Every move, pick up, drop and cancel is announced through a polite live region, from MonarchReorderableList.
Remove buttons are named with the position (Remove step 1) and are 48dp targets; the add button is a 48dp MonarchButton.
A missing target is an error on the MonarchEntityPicker, read with the field and announced when it appears; it is text, not only color.
edgeCases: A step whose kind is no longer in approverTypes keeps its stored value; its menu shows no choice until one is picked.
Changing the kind drops a target the new kind does not offer, and clearing the label stores null.
Labels longer than 60 characters are cut at 60, as the web's maxLength.
Put the editor in a screen or sheet with a bounded height: a vertically scrolling parent gives the lazy list an unbounded height and fails.

examples.title: Edit a chain
examples.template:
Column(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(12.dp)) {
    MonarchApprovalChainEditor(
        value = steps,
        onValueChange = { steps = it },
        approverTypes = listOf(
            MonarchApprovalApproverType({{approverTypes.0.value}}, {{approverTypes.0.label}}),
            MonarchApprovalApproverType({{approverTypes.1.value}}, {{approverTypes.1.label}}),
            MonarchApprovalApproverType({{approverTypes.2.value}}, {{approverTypes.2.label}}),
            MonarchApprovalApproverType(
                {{approverTypes.3.value}},
                {{approverTypes.3.label}},
                targets = listOf(
                    MonarchEntityPickerEntity({{approverTypes.3.targets.0.value}}, {{approverTypes.3.targets.0.label}}),
                    MonarchEntityPickerEntity({{approverTypes.3.targets.1.value}}, {{approverTypes.3.targets.1.label}}),
                ),
                targetLabel = {{approverTypes.3.targetLabel}},
            ),
            MonarchApprovalApproverType(
                {{approverTypes.4.value}},
                {{approverTypes.4.label}},
                targets = listOf(
                    MonarchEntityPickerEntity({{approverTypes.4.targets.0.value}}, {{approverTypes.4.targets.0.label}}),
                    MonarchEntityPickerEntity({{approverTypes.4.targets.1.value}}, {{approverTypes.4.targets.1.label}}),
                ),
                targetLabel = {{approverTypes.4.targetLabel}},
            ),
        ),
        description = {{description}},
        showErrors = tried,
        removeIcon = { MonarchIcon(imageVector = SampleIcons.Close, contentDescription = null) },
        addIcon = { MonarchIcon(imageVector = SampleIcons.Plus, contentDescription = null) },
    )
    MonarchButton(
        text = {{saveLabel}},
        onClick = { tried = true },
        variant = MonarchButtonVariant.Primary,
    )
}
examples.code:
Column(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(12.dp)) {
    MonarchApprovalChainEditor(
        value = steps,
        onValueChange = { steps = it },
        approverTypes = listOf(
            MonarchApprovalApproverType("manager", "Reporting manager"),
            MonarchApprovalApproverType("manager-2", "Manager’s manager"),
            MonarchApprovalApproverType("head", "Department head"),
            MonarchApprovalApproverType(
                "role",
                "Anyone with a role",
                targets = listOf(
                    MonarchEntityPickerEntity("finance", "Finance team"),
                    MonarchEntityPickerEntity("people", "People team"),
                ),
                targetLabel = "Role",
            ),
            MonarchApprovalApproverType(
                "person",
                "A named person",
                targets = listOf(
                    MonarchEntityPickerEntity("p1", "Jo Park"),
                    MonarchEntityPickerEntity("p2", "Ana Ruiz"),
                ),
                targetLabel = "Person",
            ),
        ),
        description = "Each step is decided by one of the people it names. A step whose approver is the requester is skipped.",
        showErrors = tried,
        removeIcon = { MonarchIcon(imageVector = SampleIcons.Close, contentDescription = null) },
        addIcon = { MonarchIcon(imageVector = SampleIcons.Plus, contentDescription = null) },
    )
    MonarchButton(
        text = "Save chain",
        onClick = { tried = true },
        variant = MonarchButtonVariant.Primary,
    )
}
